## ⚠️ IMPORTANT

If you are reporting a security vulnerability, **do not** include sensitive details in this public issue.

Instead, send an email to the address listed in `SECURITY.md` with:

- Description of the vulnerability
- Steps to reproduce
- Affected components and versions
- Any proof-of-concept (if available)

This template is for tracking the public follow-up after the vulnerability has been disclosed and addressed.

## Post-disclosure tracking

- [ ] Vulnerability has been reported privately
- [ ] Fix has been implemented
- [ ] Fix has been tested
- [ ] Fix has been released
- [ ] Public disclosure has been made
